name: Shred
description: The first clip is cut into paper strips that drop away at uneven speeds, tilting as they fall. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: stagger
params.description: Spread of the start times, as a part of the transition

params.name: tilt
params.description: Largest tilt of a falling strip, in radians

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the cut edges and shadow
